questions.question: Konteyner va virtual mashina farqi?
questions.explanation: Konteyner — o'ralgan jarayon, 'kichik VM' emas. Oqibatlari: yadro umumiy (security chegarasi zaifroq — shuning uchun ko'p tenantli muhitda gVisor/Firecracker), host yadrosiga bog'liqlik (Linux image Windows yadrosida ishlamaydi). Image — qatlamli fayl tizimi, konteyner esa shu image'dan ishga tushgan jarayon.

questions.question: Nega har kod o'zgarishida build 5 daqiqa ketadi? Tuzatish?
questions.snippet:
FROM node:20
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
RUN npm ci
RUN npm run build
CMD ["node", "dist/main.js"]
questions.explanation: Docker qatlamlarni keshlaydi: qatlam inputi o'zgarmasa qayta bajarilmaydi. To'g'ri tartib: kam o'zgaradigan narsa yuqorida. Yana: .dockerignore (node_modules, .git), multi-stage build bilan yakuniy image'da faqat dist va production bog'liqliklar, root bo'lmagan user, aniq versiyali base image (node:20.11-alpine, latest emas).

questions.question: Image va container farqi nima?
questions.explanation: Image — o'zgarmas, qatlamli shablon (read-only layer'lar). Container — image'ning ishga tushgan nusxasi: ustiga yoziladigan qatlam + izolyatsiya qilingan jarayon.

questions.question: Dockerfile'dagi asosiy instruksiyalar: FROM, RUN, COPY, CMD, ENTRYPOINT, EXPOSE, ENV — har biri nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: FROM — asos image; RUN — build paytida buyruq (yangi layer); COPY — fayl ko'chirish; CMD — default argument; ENTRYPOINT — doimiy bajariladigan dastur; EXPOSE — hujjat (portni ochmaydi); ENV — muhit o'zgaruvchisi.

questions.question: `docker run -p 8080:80`, `-v`, `-e`, `--rm`, `-d` flaglari nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: -p host:container port mapping; -v volume/bind mount; -e env; --rm to'xtaganda o'chirish; -d fonda ishlatish.

questions.question: Volume, bind mount va tmpfs farqi?
questions.explanation: Volume — Docker boshqaradigan papka (/var/lib/docker/volumes), portativ; bind mount — hostdagi aniq yo'l; tmpfs — RAM'da, vaqtinchalik.

questions.question: Docker registry bilan ishlash: login, tag, push, pull. Private registry?
questions.explanation: Image registry'da saqlanadi (Docker Hub, GHCR, ECR, Harbor). Nom: registry/namespace/repo:tag. docker tag bilan nom beriladi, docker push yuboradi.

questions.question: `docker ps`, `images`, `logs`, `exec`, `rm`, `rmi`, `system prune` — asosiy buyruqlar nima qiladi?
questions.explanation: ps — container'lar; images — image'lar; logs — stdout/stderr; exec — ishlab turgan container ichida buyruq; rm/rmi — o'chirish; system prune — keraksiz narsalarni tozalash.

questions.question: Multi-stage build nima va nega kerak?
questions.explanation: Bitta Dockerfile'da bir nechta FROM: birinchi bosqichda kompilyator bilan build, oxirgisiga faqat binary ko'chiriladi. Image kichik, xavfsiz, build tool'lar production'ga tushmaydi.

questions.question: `ARG` va `ENV` farqi? Secret'ni `ARG` bilan berish nega xavfli?
questions.explanation: ARG — faqat build vaqtida mavjud; ENV — build va container ishlayotganda ham. ARG qiymati image tarixida (`docker history`) ko'rinadi, shuning uchun secret uchun yaramaydi — `--secret` mount ishlatiladi.

questions.question: `COPY` va `ADD` farqi? Qaysi birini ishlatish kerak?
questions.explanation: Ikkalasi fayl ko'chiradi. ADD qo'shimcha: URL'dan yuklaydi va lokal tar arxivni avtomatik ochadi — kutilmagan xatti-harakat. Default COPY; ADD faqat tar ochish kerak bo'lsa.

questions.question: OverlayFS va Copy-on-Write: image layer'lari container'da qanday ishlaydi?
questions.explanation: Image layer'lari read-only, ustiga har container uchun yupqa yoziladigan layer qo'yiladi. Faylni o'zgartirish uni yuqori layer'ga nusxalaydi (CoW). Container o'chsa — yozilganlar yo'qoladi; doimiy data volume'da.

questions.question: Production image hajmini kamaytirishning eng samarali yo'li?
questions.explanation: Katta image — sekin deploy, sekin autoscaling, katta hujum yuzasi. Qo'shimcha: slim/alpine yoki distroless base, RUN'larni birlashtirib cache'ni o'chirish (apt-get clean), .dockerignore. Go uchun yakuniy image scratch/distroless'da bir necha MB bo'lishi mumkin.

questions.question: Docker layer cache qanday ishlaydi va Dockerfile tartibi nega muhim?
questions.explanation: Har instruksiya layer; instruksiya va kirish fayllari o'zgarmasa cache ishlatiladi. Bitta layer o'zgarsa undan keyingilar hammasi qayta quriladi — kam o'zgaradiganlarni yuqoriga qo'y.

questions.question: CMD va ENTRYPOINT farqi; shell form va exec form?
questions.explanation: ENTRYPOINT — doimiy dastur, CMD — unga default argument. Exec form (JSON array) jarayonni PID 1 qiladi va signal oladi; shell form /bin/sh -c orqali ishlaydi, SIGTERM ilovaga yetmaydi.

questions.question: Docker network turlari: bridge, host, none, overlay. Container'lar bir-birini qanday topadi?
questions.explanation: bridge — default, NAT; host — host network stack; none — tarmoqsiz; overlay — ko'p host (Swarm). User-defined bridge'da Docker embedded DNS (127.0.0.11) container nomini resolve qiladi.

questions.question: `docker stop` va `docker kill` farqi? Restart policy'lar?
questions.explanation: stop — SIGTERM, timeout (10s) keyin SIGKILL; kill — darhol SIGKILL (yoki --signal). Restart: no, on-failure[:N], always, unless-stopped.

questions.question: Container ichida nima bo'layotganini qanday debug qilasan?
questions.explanation: docker logs -f, docker exec -it sh, docker inspect, docker stats, docker events, docker top; distroless bo'lsa docker debug yoki --pid/--network bilan sidecar.

questions.question: Docker HEALTHCHECK qanday ishlaydi va nima uchun kerak?
questions.explanation: Container ichida davriy buyruq ishlatadi; holat starting/healthy/unhealthy. Compose depends_on va Swarm rolling update shundan foydalanadi. Oddiy Docker unhealthy container'ni o'zi restart qilmaydi.

questions.question: Container resurs limitlari: `--memory`, `--cpus`, `--pids-limit`. Limit oshsa nima bo'ladi?
questions.explanation: Cgroups orqali. Memory oshsa — kernel OOM killer jarayonni o'ldiradi (exit 137, OOMKilled=true). CPU limit — throttling (sekinlashadi, o'lmaydi). pids-limit — fork bomb'dan himoya.

questions.question: Docker logging: log qayerga yoziladi, disk to'lib qolishining oldini qanday olasan?
questions.explanation: Default json-file driver /var/lib/docker/containers/<id>/<id>-json.log ga, rotatsiyasiz yozadi. max-size/max-file qo'y yoki local/journald/fluentd driver ishlat. Ilova stdout'ga yozishi kerak.

questions.question: `docker system df` 80 GB ko'rsatyapti. Disk nima bilan to'ladi va qanday tozalaysan?
questions.explanation: Dangling image'lar, to'xtagan container'lar, ishlatilmagan volume'lar, build cache, katta log fayllar. prune buyruqlari bilan tanlab tozalanadi.

questions.question: `docker build` context nima, `.dockerignore` nega kerak?
questions.explanation: Context — build'ga yuboriladigan papka (odatda .). Hammasi daemon'ga uzatiladi. .dockerignore keraksiz/maxfiy fayllarni chiqarib tashlaydi: build tez, cache barqaror, secret image'ga tushmaydi.

questions.question: Container ishga tushib darhol to'xtaydi (`Exited (0)` yoki `Exited (1)`). Sabablari va debug?
questions.explanation: Container asosiy process (PID 1) tugashi bilan to'xtaydi. Exit 0 — process ishini tugatdi (masalan foreground'da emas, daemon rejimiga o'tdi); exit 1 — app xatosi. docker logs, inspect, entrypoint'ni override qilib ichiga kirish.

questions.question: Container ichidagi app `localhost:5432` dagi DB'ga ulana olmayapti, host'da esa ishlaydi. Nega?
questions.explanation: Container o'z network namespace'iga ega: uning localhost'i — container'ning o'zi, host emas. Compose/user network'da service nomi (`db:5432`), host'dagi servisga — `host.docker.internal` yoki host gateway IP.

questions.question: Image'dagi zaifliklarni qanday topasiz va CI'da qanday to'xtatasiz?
questions.explanation: Trivy/Grype bilan image scan; CI'da HIGH/CRITICAL topilsa pipeline fail. Kamaytirish: minimal base (distroless/alpine), muntazam rebuild, ishlatilmaydigan paketlarni olib tashlash, non-root.

questions.question: Zombie process nima va container'da nega `tini` / `--init` kerak?
questions.explanation: Container'da app PID 1 bo'ladi. PID 1 orphan child'larni `wait()` qilmasa zombie to'planadi va SIGTERM'ning default handler'i yo'q. tini kichik init: signalni uzatadi va zombie'larni yig'adi.

questions.question: `/var/run/docker.sock`'ni container'ga mount qilish va `--privileged` nega xavfli?
questions.explanation: Docker socket'ga kirish = host'da root: istalgan container'ni host / bilan mount qilib ishga tushirish mumkin. --privileged barcha capability va device'larni beradi, izolyatsiya deyarli yo'q. Ikkalasi ham container escape.

questions.question: Docker'ni ishlatmasdan CI'da (Kubernetes runner'da) image qanday build qilinadi? Kaniko, BuildKit, Buildah?
questions.explanation: Docker-in-Docker privileged talab qiladi. Kaniko — Dockerfile'ni userspace'da, daemon'siz build qiladi; BuildKit rootless rejimi; Buildah/Podman — daemon'siz. Hammasi OCI image chiqaradi.

questions.question: Container'ni read-only rejimda qanday ishga tushirasiz va nega?
questions.explanation: `--read-only` root filesystem'ni faqat o'qishga qiladi: hujumchi binary yoza olmaydi, app tasodifan konteyner ichiga data yozmaydi. Yozish kerak joylar — tmpfs yoki volume.

questions.question: Go servis uchun production image: qaysi qurilish to'g'ri?
questions.explanation: Toolchain'li image: 1GB+ hajm, ko'p CVE, ichida kompilyator va shell — hujum yuzasi. Distroless/scratch bilan bir necha o'n MB. Eslatmalar: `scratch`da TLS uchun `ca-certificates` va zone ma'lumotlari ko'chiriladi, `CGO_ENABLED=0` static bo'lishi uchun, layer keshi uchun `go mod download` alohida qatlamda.

questions.question: Docker container izolyatsiyasi qanday qurilgan va u VM'dek xavfsizmi?
questions.explanation: Namespace (pid, net, mnt, uts, ipc, user), cgroups (resurs), capabilities, seccomp, AppArmor/SELinux. Kernel umumiy — kernel exploit host'ni oladi, VM'dek kuchli chegara emas.

questions.question: Docker arxitekturasi: docker CLI, dockerd, containerd, runc qanday bog'langan?
questions.explanation: CLI REST API orqali dockerd'ga; dockerd containerd'ga (gRPC); containerd shim orqali runc'ni chaqiradi; runc OCI spec bo'yicha namespace/cgroup yaratib jarayonni ishga tushiradi va chiqadi.

questions.question: Image'ni tag bilan emas digest bilan pin qilish va image supply chain xavfsizligi?
questions.explanation: Tag o'zgaruvchan (latest qayta yoziladi), digest (sha256) o'zgarmas. Production: digest pin, imzolash (cosign), SBOM, vulnerability scan, minimal base image.

questions.question: Multi-arch image (amd64 + arm64) qanday quriladi?
questions.explanation: docker buildx + BuildKit: --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64, natija bitta tag ostida manifest list. QEMU emulyatsiya sekin — Go'da GOARCH bilan cross-compile yoki native builder'lar tez.

questions.question: Rootless Docker va userns-remap nima? Qachon kerak?
questions.explanation: Container ichidagi root host'da oddiy UID'ga map qilinadi. Container escape bo'lsa ham host root olinmaydi. Kamchilik: <1024 port, ba'zi storage/network cheklovlari.

questions.question: Docker build CI'da sekin (har safar 10+ daqiqa). Qanday tezlashtirasiz?
questions.explanation: Layer tartibi (dependency avval, kod keyin), .dockerignore, BuildKit cache mount, CI'da remote cache (registry yoki gha), multi-stage parallel. O'lchash: build log'da qaysi qadam CACHED emas.
